نستنكف (form X)
# نَسْتَنْكِفُ (nastankifu) /nas.tan.ki.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَنْكَفَ (istankafa)
# نَسْتَنْكِفَ (nastankifa) /nas.tan.ki.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَنْكَفَ (istankafa)
# نَسْتَنْكِفْ (nastankif) /nas.tan.kif/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَنْكَفَ (istankafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
